title: Lawyers in Lucknow protest for Advocates Protection Act and other demands

ai.summary: Lawyers in Uttar Pradesh held a large protest in Lucknow demanding implementation of the Advocates Protection Act and other demands including toll tax exemptions and restoration of chambers.

facts.claim: Lawyers in Uttar Pradesh held a large protest in Lucknow
facts.quote: Lawyers in Uttar Pradesh held a large protest in Lucknow calling for the implementation of the Advocates Protection Act.
Nearly 48 districts participated, removing police barricades en route to the Legislative Assembly.

facts.claim: They requested that the draft Act be discussed with all Bar Associations before enforcement
facts.quote: They requested that the draft Act be discussed with all Bar Associations before enforcement.

facts.claim: Other demands included toll tax exemptions, restoration of chambers, and insurance schemes
facts.quote: Other demands included toll tax exemptions, restoration of chambers, and insurance schemes.

facts.claim: Bar leaders warned of work stoppage and a mahapanchayat if demands remain unmet within 15 days
facts.quote: Bar leaders warned of work stoppage and a mahapanchayat if demands remain unmet within 15 days.
